ns2:course.label: Advanced Computer Networks
ns2:course.description: Advanced concepts in computer networks, including congestion control, quality of service, naming, routing, wireless networks, Internet architecture, measurement, network security, and selected recent research directions. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: CS 438 or ECE 438.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: CS 438 or ECE 438.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Computer Science or Bioinformatics major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
